description: nf-core/nanoseq samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 3.1.0 schema. Oxford Nanopore QC, demultiplexing and alignment.

protocol.help: REQUIRED. The kind of Nanopore library. No default — it must come from the user.

skip_alignment.help: TRUE by curated default. The 3.1.0 schema exposes no fasta/genome/gtf parameter, so there is no verified way to hand this pipeline a reference from the Luria refs tree. QC + demultiplexing are well defined without one. Do not flip this to false until someone has established how 3.1.0 takes a reference.

aligner.help: Only consulted when skip_alignment is false.

required_user_params.name: protocol
required_user_params.definition: The kind of Nanopore library this cohort is. DNA = genomic DNA sequencing; cDNA = reverse-transcribed RNA; directRNA = RNA sequenced directly without reverse transcription. It changes how the reads are processed and cannot be inferred from the FASTQ.

pipeline.name: nf-core/nanoseq
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, fastq_1, fastq_2. Only sample and fastq_1 are required.
pipeline.reference_requirement: NONE as shipped. The 3.1.0 schema declares no fasta/genome/gtf parameter, which is why skip_alignment defaults to true here.

validation_rules: The file consumed by the pipeline must be comma-separated (CSV).
sample and fastq_1 must be populated; Nanopore reads are single-file, so fastq_2 is normally blank.
protocol must be answered by the user — DNA, cDNA or directRNA. Never default it.
Do NOT pass --genome, --fasta or --gtf: the 3.1.0 schema declares none of them.
Only route ACTUAL Nanopore libraries here. An Illumina cohort sent to nanoseq will produce nonsense, not an error.
notes: Long-read QC and demultiplexing. Verify the cohort really is Oxford Nanopore before launching — check the sample's platform/instrument metadata, do not assume from the assay name.

sources.label: nf-core/nanoseq nextflow_schema.json @ 3.1.0
sources.notes: protocol is required; no fasta/genome/gtf param exists at this revision.

sources.label: nf-core/nanoseq assets/schema_input.json @ 3.1.0
sources.notes: Authoritative: only sample and fastq_1 are required. The older group/replicate/barcode/genome sheet no longer applies.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/nanoseq input samplesheet.

fastq_1.validation_hints: Absolute Luria path from the sample's primary-data metadata.

fastq_2.description: Second read file. Nanopore output is single-file, so this is normally blank.
fastq_2.validation_hints: Leave blank unless the cohort genuinely has paired files.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/nanoseq samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK D.SEQ cohort of Nanopore libraries.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected for Oxford Nanopore long-read cohorts.
population_priority: Confirm from platform/instrument metadata that these really are Nanopore reads before proceeding.
One row per D.SEQ leaf; sample = the UID; fastq_2 blank.
Ask the user for protocol; do not infer it from the assay title.
final_checks: protocol was answered by the user.
The cohort was verified as Nanopore, not assumed.
